question: Should `bus:pubsub` become a supported Workspaces custom-widget capability with the proposed same-tab trust and delivery boundary?
rationale: This exposes a new communication primitive to untrusted agent-authored iframe code and establishes a lasting manifest and bridge contract; tests can validate implementation mechanics but cannot choose the intended security and compatibility policy.

options.title: Sponsor after hardening
options.body: Approve the capability direction after the quota survives iframe reloads and real browser proof demonstrates isolation, no echo, and teardown behavior.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Keep the PR and canonical issue open until the broader Workspaces roadmap explicitly defines widget-to-widget trust and API stability.

options.title: Keep widgets isolated
options.body: Decline the capability and preserve the existing model where custom widgets communicate only with the trusted parent.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after hardening
recommendation.body: Approve the capability direction after the quota survives iframe reloads and real browser proof demonstrates isolation, no echo, and teardown behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current Workspaces sandbox and bridge architecture that owns this security boundary.
